title: ELO daily file
description: Aggregated ladder demand per item class and build node, plus scoring parameters. Rebuilt after each crawl. Shipped gzip-compressed. Never contains account or character names. See shared/schema/README.md.

patch_ref.description: game_patch of the patch file this daily file must be used with.

validated.description: false until thresholds are validated against trade listings. While false, the app never shows KEEP (verdicts capped at PRICE CHECK).

oldest_gear_days.description: Age of the oldest gear snapshot used.

ladder_coverage.description: Share of public ladder characters with fetched gear.

tier_gate.description: Relative tier gate: a roll qualifies if its tier is within the best max(always_top_tiers, ceil(top_fraction × ladder length)) tiers of its family on that base.

min_effective_accounts_own_node.description: A main-skill node is shown on its own only above this (design: ~150).

core_min_effective_obs.description: Minimum effective observations for a core mod (design: ~10).

stale_after_days.description: Snapshot older than this (from crawl_date) → verdicts capped at PRICE CHECK with a 'low data' marker.

build_nodes.description: Build tree: 'all' (per item class overall) → archetype → main skill.

demand.description: demand[item_class][node_id] → mod demand for that build node. Item class keys match the patch file.

base_values.description: poe.ninja BaseType prices used by the base-value boost.

special_prices.description: poe.ninja prices for items ELO does not score (uniques, cluster jewels).

thresholds.description: null = not validated yet. Any null threshold needed for a decision caps the verdict at PRICE CHECK.

price_check_fit.description: Minimum fit for PRICE CHECK from a partial or niche fit.

min_build_accounts.description: A build with fewer accounts is 'niche': it is never the best buyer for KEEP; a KEEP-level fit for it gives PRICE CHECK naming that build (owner decision 2026-11-23).

craftable_discount.description: Fraction removed from the demand of naturally rolled craftable stats (0–1). How it applies is an open question; fixtures use 0.

base_value_min_chaos.description: Base-value boost applies at or above this chaos price.

base_value_min_ilvl.description: Base-value boost applies at or above this item level (design: 84).

shown_on_own.description: true = can be named as a buyer and filtered on. false = its archetype stands in for it.

low_data.description: true = verdicts naming this build are capped at PRICE CHECK with a 'low data' marker.

effective_items.description: W_b: weighted item count for this class and node.

mods.description: Every mod with non-zero demand, sorted by demand descending. Core mods have core = true (6–8 per node).

demand_low.description: Cautious lower-bound demand used by item scoring (computed on the server).

share.description: Smoothed observed share p_obs(m|b) of tier-gated rolls.

demand_tier.description: null = near-zero demand, no tier shown. Bench-craftable flags live only in the patch file (item_classes[*].craftable_stat_ids).
